definition: a person or animal with whom one spends time or travels
hook: Your closest companion has bread baked into their name.
modernAnchor: A road trip partner. A loyal friend. Someone who shows up when things get hard.
journey: In Latin, com means together. Panis means bread - the staff of life, the most basic thing shared.
A companio was the person you broke bread with. Someone trusted enough to share a meal.
Medieval soldiers divided rations. Travelers split loaves on the road. That sharing built the bond.
Friendship, in its oldest form, was not a feeling. It was a meal shared between travelers.
